$schema: Theme vocabulary for JD → theme derivation. Themes are fixed; add one only by adding bullets that support it.

themes.label: Revenue / marketing operations
themes.covers: Owning the GTM tech stack, process design, SLAs, program throughput, funnel mechanics, KPI definition.
themes.evidence: The GTM tech stack and funnel mechanics — strongest at Sr. Director (2021–2024) and Engagio.

themes.label: Data, analytics, and modelling
themes.covers: Pipeline waterfall models, ICP analysis, attribution, forecasting, reporting architecture, data warehouse/CDP activation.
themes.evidence: The pipeline waterfall model, double-funnel reporting, and the Data Solution Experts practice.

themes.label: Technical pre-sales and solutions
themes.covers: Advising enterprise prospects, solution architecture, technical discovery, the expert function between Product and the field.
themes.evidence: The Data Solution Experts function, $13M in advisory influence, Ads Assist.

themes.label: Product partnership and roadmap
themes.covers: Voice of the customer into roadmap, product concepts originated, platform merges, QA, multi-product GTM.
themes.evidence: Buying Groups origination, the ABX Cloud merge, the single-to-multi-product shift.

themes.label: Building — A.I. and automation
themes.covers: Agentic workflows shipped hands-on, internal tooling, automation platforms, deployment.
themes.evidence: The Opp Resource Log agent, the Slack CRM updater, the citizen developer program, the London demo, and the full stacks owned at StreamSets and Ayla.

themes.label: Evangelism and market presence
themes.covers: Live speaking, executive forums, thought leadership, playbook libraries, field enablement.
themes.evidence: $25M+ influenced pipeline from market presence, $5M+ personally, the 30+ playbook library.

themes.label: Team leadership and scale
themes.covers: Hiring, org design, managing managers, global teams, KPI ownership, coverage models.
themes.evidence: The global Expert team, the DSE growth proposal, 2 FTEs to 8 at Sr. Director, and the China/Taiwan teams at Ayla.

themes.label: Migrations and consolidation
themes.covers: Post-acquisition data and platform migrations under deadline, single-source-of-truth work.
themes.evidence: InsideView/DemandMatrix in 3 months, the Engagio and Pardot-to-Marketo migrations, and the HubSpot-to-Marketo moves at Ayla and Goji.

derivation.method: Read the JD. Pick 2-4 themes, most important first. Weight by what the role is measured on, not by what it mentions in passing — a JD that says "AI" once in a boilerplate paragraph is not a systems role.

examples.jd: Director of Revenue Operations — own the funnel model, forecasting, and the RevOps team
Principal Solutions Architect — technical pre-sales for enterprise data customers
Head of GTM Systems & AI — build the agentic workflows behind the revenue engine
Product Marketing Lead — voice of the customer, launches, field enablement
VP Marketing Operations — scale the team through an acquisition

knownGaps.note: Themes deliberately absent from the vocabulary because the pool has no honest evidence for them. If a JD leads on one of these, coverage() reports it and the app should treat the role as a stretch — not paper over it.
absent: demand gen media buying at scale

evidenceNote: `evidence` is qualitative on purpose — it names the work, never a bullet count. Counts drift the moment a bullet is added to career.json, so `coverage()` is the single source of truth for how many bullets back a theme and whether support is strong, thin, or absent. Never hardcode counts here.
